observations: Stable authority identity and volatile heartbeat liveness must be verified separately so safe renewal does not invalidate an authorization.
A completed immutable effect receipt is replay evidence rather than a new effect authorization and must remain side-effect-free after later revocation.
The pre-claim verifier narrows but cannot remove the final provider race; provider idempotency and revocation tokens remain required.
State-only heartbeat commits can safely advance main during exact-head CI when the result branch excludes the lease file and mergeability is freshly recomputed.
reason: The bounded deterministic guard passed without evidence justifying a prompt Candidate or global activation; Task Evaluate and the next Root should decide the subsequent falsifiable unit.
